name: io.github.micropage-sh/mcp
title: Micropage
description: Create, edit and publish micropage.sh landing pages and blog posts from markup.

environmentVariables.name: MICROPAGE_DEPLOY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Deploy token for headless use (CI). Set together with MICROPAGE_DEPLOY_PROJECT. Without both, the server uses the session from `micropage login`.

environmentVariables.name: MICROPAGE_DEPLOY_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: UUID of the project the deploy token belongs to. Required when MICROPAGE_DEPLOY_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: MICROPAGE_MCP_ALLOW_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Let publish_post email the newsletter subscriber list.

environmentVariables.name: MICROPAGE_MCP_SUBMISSIONS
environmentVariables.description: Register the form submission tools, which read visitor-entered personal data.

environmentVariables.name: MICROPAGE_CONFIG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the CLI session (config.json). Defaults to ~/.micropage.
